visualCharacteristics.structure: stacked list of the newest blog posts: uppercase date line above a card holding the linked post title and the full post body (text and images)

contentPattern: Single config row authored as key/value cells: `count` (number of posts, default 2) and optional `index` (query index path, default /query-index.json). Post content is fetched dynamically from the query index and each post's .plain.html; nothing else is authored in the block.
